scope: Independent read-only source review; preparation and commit procedure were not executed by this reviewer.
requirements: Run only after acceptance.json and all required gates are PASS, final report and receipt set are complete, and independent history/source freshness checks pass.
Exclusive temporary index starts from exact C2FB parent; git add -A captures preserved current worktree without checkout, reset, clean, stash or rebase.
Every baseline path remains present; changed paths are scope-checked; raw working bytes equal staged Git blob bytes before tree seal.
Changed-content inventory excludes only itself; complete immutable tree inventory includes its own blob and hash separately.
Commit phase checks fixed parent, old head, branch and subject; revalidates every changed row length, SHA256 and exact blob bytes plus the inventory own hash/blob.
A final temporary-index tree comparison catches staged path/content changes after sealing before commit-tree.
Commit-tree uses exactly one fixed C2FB parent; subject, parent, complete tree identity and full tree inventory are verified before branch movement.
Branch update is compare-and-swap from exact old C2CB head; real index synchronization uses read-tree without -u, so it does not overwrite worktree files.
After branch update the tool verifies clean resumed worktree, unchanged clean main, and diff whitespace; it never pushes or tags.
addressedFinding: Initial commit phase compared only normalized Git tree; it now also verifies original raw bytes and inventory identity immediately before tree comparison/commit construction.
conditions: Read-only procedure review is not an executed accepted-commit receipt and does not substitute for final acceptance, final source freshness, historical byte preservation, or post-commit verification.
